sources: Main abstract and Results measurement precision
finding: Best 6.4e-7 RIU is repeatability precision. Calibration is at sodium D line near 589.29 nm while optical measurements are 532/1064 nm. SI cannot correct intermediate concentrations and estimates wavelength-dependent bias as large as 0.63%, far above refractometer stated ±3e-4 RIU accuracy.
resolution: Keep measurement precision, reference accuracy, and wavelength/model bias as separate fields; do not claim absolute RI accuracy of 6.4e-7.
